name: Longer Nano 6W
tagline: Longer's entry portable: compact diode for small projects
tldr: Longer Nano 6W is a compact portable engraver for small gifts and learning. Pairs with Longer's accessory ecosystem. Upgrade to Nano Pro 12W if you need real cutting speed.
mainObjective: Detailed engraving on organics and coated metal: occasional thin cuts only

priceRange.note: Official Longer store, Oct 2026: $400 to $960 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Galvo head rated by Longer at up to 5,000 mm/s for quick small marks
Basic set at $399.99 on Longer's store (October 2026)
Compact and portable, works with LightBurn, LaserGRBL and LaserBurn
cons: Precision of 0.05 mm per Longer, coarser than the field-lens Nano Pro
Small 100 × 100 mm field unless you add the slide extension
Cutting 3 mm basswood takes ~9–15 min in our benchmarks
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 6W SKU on Longer Nano. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Optimize for engraving: lower DPI on photos, higher scan speed on line art after test burns. Air assist still helps clarity. Compare benchmark times on the next tier before assuming you need more power.
primaryUse: Engraving-first desktop diode for makers who prioritize mark quality over cut speed

editorialDepth.advantages: Longer Nano 6W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production: see 12W in the line. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.

faq.question: What can the Nano 6W cut?
faq.answer: Longer gives a 6 mm wood cutting depth. The Nano is a galvo machine, so cuts are built from many fast passes: in our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 9–15 min. Paper, card and fabric are easy; treat thicker wood as a slow, multi-pass job.

faq.question: How big can a design be on the Nano 6W?
faq.answer: Longer lists a 100 × 100 mm working field, extendable to 100 × 300 mm with the slide extension. That suits tags, jewellery boxes, phone cases and leather patches, not signs or panels.

faq.question: Nano 6W or Nano Pro 12W?
faq.answer: On Longer's store in October 2026 the basic sets were $399.99 (6W) and $559.99 (Pro 12W). For $160 more, the Pro adds a second diode and an F-theta field lens, with a 0.01 mm precision claim against 0.05 mm and a 10 mm cutting depth against 6 mm. The 6W is enough for small engraving work.

standoutFeatures.title: Galvo speed in a small box
standoutFeatures.body: Up to 5,000 mm/s engraving and 32,000 mm/s preview according to Longer, ideal for repeated small marks.

standoutFeatures.title: Entry price for a galvo diode
standoutFeatures.body: $399.99 for the basic set in October 2026, with Pro and Pro Max sets adding accessories.
